newsitem.title: USA: Redbook sales seen rising 0.5 to 1.0 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Redbook sales seen rising 0.5 to 1.0 pct in Dec.

text.p: Traders and analysts in the U.S. Treasury market said the Redbook Retail Sales Index is expected to rise between 0.5 and 1.0 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis for the four weeks to December 28 when the data are reported later Tuesday.

Talk about the Redbook Index followed a 1.9-percent increase in the BTM/Schroders index of U.S. retail sales on a seasonally adjusted basis in the same period. On a weekly basis, the BTM/Schroders index rose 1.0 percent in the week ended December 28 versus the prior week.
Lynch, Jones & Ryan Inc will report the Redbook Index at 1455 EST/1955 GMT.
